cases.title: Register with a valid phone number
cases.precondition: Postgres test DB is migrated. SMS/FCM sandbox env is set (boot fails if missing). Nest `/api/v1` is the only client API. Case `T-001` (Register with a valid phone number) in `CASE-AUTH`. Primary UI `m.auth.phone`; primary REST `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request`. Envelope ADR-0027. Role/scope AuthZ on.
steps: Seed the minimum Postgres rows for `T-001` (users/memberships/jobs/shifts as the group requires). No Firebase fixtures.
Open `m.auth.phone` on the channel under test (mobile iOS+Android and/or web/admin as mapped).
Exercise `Register with a valid phone number` through `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request` (and follow-up group REST). Send `Authorization: Bearer` and `Idempotency-Key` on critical POSTs.
Assert HTTP + envelope `{data,meta}` or `{error,meta}` with stable English `error.code` and localized `error.message`.
Assert the Postgres invariant (row, unique constraint, ledger, outbox, or scoped list) — not a client-only flag.

cases.expected_result: POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request then verify creates a unique users row (E.164), hashed otp_challenges, refresh_sessions, and JWT. No Firebase Auth. Next screen m.worker.onboarding.profile after role select.
